confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Manila prices, brought forward to July 2026. Not checked against live menus, listings or booking sites. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable; hostel and hotel rates vary widely by district and season. Cocktail and wine were set from a beer-relative multiple because direct knowledge is weaker. FX was read from a search snippet of the RBA homepage panel (14 Oct 2026), not the F11.1 table. A 15 Oct observation may exist but was not found.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Regional Southeast Asia basis: restaurant and drink anchors sit above lower-cost regional capitals, and accommodation anchors reflect typical Metro Manila hostel, budget-hotel and three-star rates.
